items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: At the time, whenever Bob Cross would come through there, and his band like Fazola, Clarinet, and he's from New Orleans.

ctx.x: Do you recall any white musicians around Chicago at that time from New Orleans or that could play in the New Orleans style? Oh, yes.
Tension to. Yeah. At the time, whenever Bob Cross would come through there, and his band like Fazola, Clarinet, and he's from New Orleans.
There's been so many things written about the Oliver Band in Chicago at that time and how great it was. Just how did the Oliver Band impress you?
